audit_scope.description: Trust model for EIP-8072 (transaction inclusion monitoring), EIP-2464 (eth/65 transaction announcements), EIP-8081 (Hegota upgrade governance), elliptic curve precompile operations, and EIP-4844 (blob transactions).
in_scope: Elliptic curve signature verification and precompile execution
EIP-4844 blob transaction validation, KZG commitment verification, and blob propagation
out_of_scope: EIP-8081 Hegota governance process (meta-governance EIP with no runtime impact)

misclassified_entities.reason: The node processing transaction inclusion is the EL client itself, not an external entity.
EIP authors are governance participants, not protocol-level external entities. EIP-8081 is a meta-governance EIP with no runtime protocol impact.
misclassified_entities.correct_classification: Governance entity (out of scope for protocol trust model)

trusted_external_entities.name: User Application
trusted_external_entities.rationale: User applications subscribing to transaction inclusion events are unauthenticated RPC consumers.

trusted_external_entities.name: User
trusted_external_entities.rationale: End users interacting via RPC are unauthenticated external consumers.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Node
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peers sending transaction announcements (NewPooledTransactionHashes) are unauthenticated P2P participants.

trusted_external_entities.name: Signature Provider
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Signatures are provided by external signers; validity is verified cryptographically, not by trust.

trusted_external_entities.name: Precompile Caller
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Any contract can invoke elliptic curve precompiles with arbitrary input data.

trusted_external_entities.name: User (EIP-4844)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Users submitting blob transactions are unauthenticated; blob data and KZG commitments must be validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Node (EIP-4844)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peers propagating blob sidecars are unauthenticated; KZG proofs must be verified.

trusted_external_entities.name: Network
trusted_external_entities.rationale: The network layer is unauthenticated and subject to adversarial manipulation.

trusted_external_entities.name: Calling Contract
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: EVM CALL to point evaluation precompile (0x0a)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Any contract can invoke the point evaluation precompile with arbitrary inputs.

boundary_edges.data_crossing_boundary: ECDSA signature components (v, r, s) for ecrecover
boundary_edges.trust_boundary: Cryptographic boundary - verified by math, not trust

boundary_edges.data_crossing_boundary: Arbitrary input data to elliptic curve precompiles
boundary_edges.trust_boundary: EVM execution boundary - any contract can call

boundary_edges.data_crossing_boundary: Type 0x03 blob transactions with KZG commitments and blob data
Point evaluation precompile inputs (versioned hash, x, y, commitment, proof)
boundary_edges.trust_boundary: EVM execution boundary - any contract can call

gaps: EIP-8081 Hegota is a governance-only EIP; its external entity (EIP author) has no protocol-level trust boundary.
EXT-NODE in EIP-8072 was misclassified as external when it represents the local node.
